design_scope: Fixed additional record-corruption evaluation, not blind generalization or an independent neural experiment. Authors have inspected the checker and earlier development cases.
case_unit: One declared worker seed block with the complete 2 conditions x 2 laws x 3 faults matrix. Source blocks selected by seeded shuffle within each family; target row selected by seeded draw without outcome filtering.
normalization: Deep-copy raw source rows, mutate raw rows, then let every evaluation arm freshly normalize those exact same rows. No Evidence-only corruption.

valid_families.name: unaltered
valid_families.generation: Use the complete declared seed block without mutation.

valid_families.name: legal_nonframe_actuation
valid_families.generation: Reuse an unmodified source block containing existing valid off-frame actuator events; do not round or invent an event.

valid_families.name: legal_worker_seed_partition
valid_families.generation: Reuse an unmodified complete seed block declared as a worker subset of the registered seed matrix.

valid_families.name: legal_feedback_dependence
valid_families.generation: Reuse unmodified records where common exogenous variates coexist with different realized input events (fly) or controller/plant histories (tank).

invalid_families.name: uniform_identity
invalid_families.generation: Change one raw uniform_sha256 to a different syntactically valid 64-hex digest.

invalid_families.name: mask_identity
invalid_families.generation: Change one raw mask_sha256 to a different syntactically valid 64-hex digest.

invalid_families.name: seed_identity
invalid_families.generation: Set one seed to its original seed plus 1000000, outside the declared worker seed set.

invalid_families.name: condition_identity
invalid_families.generation: Relabel one raw bearing/inflow condition as the other declared condition, producing a duplicate and missing matrix cell.

invalid_families.name: actuator_start
invalid_families.generation: Fly: shift the observed first burst-on subframe boundary later while retaining full observation-frame coverage; tank: shift one available_s timestamp by +0.01 s.

invalid_families.name: actuator_end
invalid_families.generation: Fly: terminate the last observed burst-on segment 1 ms early and append a walk-marked segment; tank: shift one internal applied-control event boundary by 0.01 s.

invalid_families.name: endpoint_actuator_state
invalid_families.generation: Fly: invert burst_active_at_horizon only; tank: remove an internal event boundary by merging the frame segments.

invalid_families.name: task_label_contradiction
invalid_families.generation: Invert escaped/success without changing the saved first-failure timestamp.

invalid_families.name: first_failure_time
invalid_families.generation: Change/add a finite in-horizon first contact/failure timestamp and keep the final success label consistent with that timestamp.

invalid_families.name: resource_decrease
invalid_families.generation: Choose a frame whose predecessor has resource >=1 and replace that frame resource with predecessor minus 1 (still nonnegative).

invalid_families.name: monotone_resource_bias
invalid_families.generation: Add 10 to all cumulative frame resources; for fly also add 10 to final n_total. This is known source corruption; global neural-count authenticity is not reconstructable from command logs.

invalid_families.name: truncated_exposure
invalid_families.generation: Remove the last frame while preserving declared observation horizon and other final metadata.

invalid_families.name: missing_required_header
invalid_families.generation: Delete the raw mask_sha256 header; retain the parse failure in the denominator.

invalid_families.name: uniform_binding_replacement
invalid_families.generation: Replace the input-map digest (fly) or source digest (tank) by the same wrong 64-hex value in every row; cross-record agreement alone is insufficient.

fly_additional.name: declared_burst_header
fly_additional.generation: Increase raw burst_delay_ms by 10 ms and burst_duration_ms by 10 ms in one row, without changing observed execution. Valid numeric fields but declaration/execution disagreement; retain even if every frozen checker misses it.

applicability: Structural prerequisites are checked without scoring. Any unavailable required event/resource frame is marked inapplicable with reason and retained in the manifest; not silently replaced by another source block.
out_of_scope_development_counterexample: The previously demonstrated zero-neural-logger replay is a development counterexample, not a new blind case. No saved-record check authenticates unlogged neural execution.
ground_truth: Validity is defined by the unchanged source record and declared protocol semantics, not by whether any evaluated checker detects a mutation. Script/plan will be committed and hash-bound before final evaluation; no score-dependent revisions allowed.
